style: Soft pastel children's picture-book illustration, kawaii and cozy, gentle watercolor and gouache texture, rounded shapes, dreamy soft lighting, pink lavender mint and butter-yellow palette. Background scene only: no people, no characters, no animals in the foreground, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Wide 16:9 composition with a clear open area in the lower center where a small character can stand.
